_comment: Defaults for the association add-on. A site overrides any key in its app-custom-config.json.
_comment_database: Occupancy submissions waiting for review hold personal data (names, phones, addresses), so the database is encrypted and the add-on does not load without NGDPBASE_DATABASE_KEY (storage guide; #32). A site turns on ngdpbase.database.provider sqlite and sets the key itself.

association-review.description: Review what waits for the association's approval: Occupancy information submissions (ORC 5311.09)
association-review.label: Review occupancy submissions

audit.description: An approved occupancy submission applied, as the system, naming the decider; the unit and the entry type, never the answers. Filing and deciding the review are recorded by core

occupancy-submit.description: An Occupancy information submission was received and kept for review; who sent it, the unit and the entry type, never the answers

ngdpbase.access.policies.name: Association: review
ngdpbase.access.policies.description: Admins decide occupancy submissions on day one, on core's Reviews page or the add-on's own. An approval is applied by the system, naming the decider, so deciding needs association-review alone (ngdpbase#2112); the review page finds each submission's account with search-user. identity-read, identity-manage and user-create date from when the reviewer applied an approval themselves; approval no longer uses them.

ngdpbase.access.policies.name: Association: the Executive Hub
ngdpbase.access.policies.description: The board, through core's executive role, reads the occupancy submissions waiting and decides them, on the Executive Hub, Reviews or the add-on's review page. An approval is applied by the system, naming the decider, so the role needs nothing that writes (ngdpbase#2112).
